What Storytellers from Homer to Greta Gerwig Can Teach Us About Presentations

Next Slide Please
Aug 22 2026 • 1 hr 4 mins
PK leads the team through the art and science of storytelling in presentations - from cave paintings to storyboards, from Aristotle's 3 act structure to a simple beginning-middle-end approach. We get into why conflict is your friend, why structure is story, and why the single biggest mistake most presenters make is putting too much in rather than not enough.
